claims: Blaze Pizza is offering a Buy One, Get One (BOGO) deal on 11-inch pizzas at participating locations for Pi Day 2026.
Customers can purchase one 11-inch pizza and get a second 11-inch pizza for $3.14.
Blaze Pizza's promotion runs from March 14 to April 6, 2026.
Blaze Pizza's promotion is primarily in-restaurant.
Blaze Pizza's promotion allows for custom pizzas.
Blaze Pizza's promotion is available at participating locations.
Blaze Pizza's offer is valid on 11-inch pizzas.
Blaze Pizza's promotion has potential upcharges for specialty crusts.
Some locations may require the Blaze Pizza app for the promotion.
